section_summary.extract_value: This is a methods section (3.1.2) describing the measurement instruments used in what appears to be Study X. The section details four main measurement categories: (1) Exercise Motivations Inventory (EMI-2) for measuring appearance and health goals; (2) Behavioural Regulation of Exercise Questionnaire (BREQ-2) for measuring exercise regulation subtypes; (3) Three body image measures including the Physical Appearance State and Trait Anxiety Scale (PASTAS), Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and Self-Discrepancy Index (SDI); and (4) Leisure Time Exercise Questionnaire (LTEQ) and self-reported BMI calculation. The BAS was used as the positive body image measure with 12 items, and BMI was assessed using self-reported height and weight.
